title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: when two packages ship one name and one declares its .custom override, each package's slot serves its own item (ADR-0150 D4)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoMEcsa8u1Ymjwvb5h8WsfW2)_

Refs #33131 (items 3, 1, 2)

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: semantic
Skills-docs: none — the platform skill teaches the declared override served at its base's address with no holder order; that was false only for the second-registered of two namespaces shipping one name, and is now true for both.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：两个包发布同一个名字、其中一个包在自己的 `.custom` 里声明了覆盖时，每个包的地址和列表条目都只返回它自己的那一份（六种封存类型、所有类型的全环境列表）；动作的注册表槽位由 main 上 #33166 的同一条规则负责，本 PR 加固定测试。
- 为什么改：以前第二个包对页面、应用、数据集、文档、书、映射的覆盖在自己地址上不生效，启动报告还让管理员删掉它；全环境列表把覆盖在第一个包名下重复列一次；动作会跑错包的覆盖体（第一个注册的包的槽位执行了第二个包的覆盖）。
- 风险与回滚：只影响"两个已安装包发布同一名字 + 声明覆盖"的组合，工作区内没有这种组合；回滚即还原本 PR，存储数据不变形。两个包都声明覆盖时，注册表里动作的包级条目仍只有一个裸槽位（另一个包返回自己的出厂动作，绝不返回别人的覆盖），已在卡上挂账。
- 先看：`protocol-lock-state.ts` 末尾的 `declinesStoredRow`（第 1 项），再看 `protocol-diff-delete-load.ts` 的启动普查与 `protocol-meta-list-reads.ts` 的多发布者过滤（第 2 项）；第 3 项看测试文件的 `[#33131]` describe。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/protocol-flow-custom-override.test.ts src/protocol-custom-override-bare-slot-envelope.test.ts -t 33131`，两种注册顺序、两种保存顺序全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地

## What changes

Two packages of two namespaces (alpha, beta) ship one name; one or both declare an override in their own `.custom` pair (ADR-0150 D4: a declared override binds to the package it names, never to the first-registered shipper).

- **Item 1 — the second holder's override of a sealed type did nothing** (`protocol-lock-state.ts`, `protocol-diff-delete-load.ts`). `declinesStoredRow` judged a page, app, dataset, doc, book or mapping declaration against the name's first-registered package alone, so the second package's override was declined at its own address (its shipped item served), even with the first package disabled, and the boot census `metadata_sealed_overlay_unserved` told the admin to delete it. Both now judge against every shipper, as a flow and an action already did; the census asks the same question as the door, so the two still agree. Other types keep the owner-only census.
- **Item 2 — the env-wide list misattributed an override** (`protocol-meta-list-reads.ts`). The `flow`/`action` type gate (`TWO_HOLDER_PAIR_SLOT_TYPES`) on the multi-shipper pair-slot filter is gone: for every type, the pair's slot of a declared override is dropped when two or more packages ship the name; a bundle's row only at a member its declared base ships (a pair's added member is kept).
- **Item 3 — an action ran the wrong body** (registry face). The read-side hydrator registered the pair's override row under the bare name wearing the envelope the artifact lookup answers for the pair's id; the pair ships nothing, so the lookup fell to the first-registered package, and that package's slot listed, executed and served the second package's override. While this PR was in review, #33166 (#32692) landed `pairRowEnvelopeHolder` in `protocol-registry-hydration.ts`: a pair row of a two-holder name wears the envelope of the holder `overlayRowBinding` binds it to. That is the same lookup this PR's own helper (`declaredOverrideBaseOf`) did, so the merge keeps #33166's rule as the one rule and drops this PR's helper; `protocol-registry-hydration.ts` is identical to `main`. Why that one: it is the registry's own owner rule (`overlayRowBinding`, which every overlay-slot reader follows), not a second spelling of the same answer, and it counts disabled holders, so the envelope never moves with a disable. This PR carries the item-3 pins; turning #33166's rule off turns 6 of them red (ablation R1A3).
- Semantic entry `two-shipper-declared-override-own-slot` (ADR-0087) and two changesets. With both packages overridden, the entry and changeset claim the registry's action item for one overridden package only (see Acceptance notes, S1).

## Red lines

1. **Resolution never loosened.** The served row is still judged by `isServedOverrideRowOf` alone (pair binding by column, declaration names the base, overridable type); no new door and no new predicate. Pinned by `CONTROL, alpha/beta registered first: a stranger's row declaring a holder is no override, stays unserved, and the census names it` (six sealed types, both orders).
2. **Ambiguity reported, never guessed.** No answer depends on registration order: every two-holder pin runs both orders, and `… each holder disabled in turn: the enabled holder's own item at its address` / `… the enabled holder's own item alone` show each holder's answer stands alone. The read naming no package refuses `409` while both holders are enabled (`… the read naming no package refuses 409 with both holders, and serves the enabled holder's own item with the other disabled`). The registry envelope of a pair row is the holder `overlayRowBinding` binds it to (#33166's `pairRowEnvelopeHolder`); a pair row it binds to no holder is declined, and a package-less row of a two-holder name still wears no envelope.
3. **Independently releasable.** The one-holder answers are unchanged: `CONTROL: one namespace ships the names, with its declared override: its override at its address, and the census names none`, `CONTROL: one package ships the action name, with its declared override: …` and `CONTROL: one package ships the action name, not overridden: …`, plus every pre-existing pin in both files and #33166's `webhook-stored-row-boot-hydration.test.ts` (467/467 across the four affected files). Bare-name behaviour of one holder is unchanged. ADR-0087 entry `18.two-shipper-declared-override-own-slot.ts`, `check-adr-0087-registration` green.

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/protocol-flow-custom-override.test.ts`: new describe `[#33131] two packages ship one action name, one declares an override: each slot serves its own package's item` — both orders × overridden holder, the served and execution lists, the by-name read, the layered `effective`, `registry.getPackageScopedItem`, each holder disabled in turn, and two one-holder CONTROLs. Round 1 (S1): `… both overridden: each read face serves its own override; the registry item serves the last-saved holder's override and the first-saved holder's own shipped action (carried)`, both registration orders × both save orders. The #32613 mixed pin now asserts the full action list and the other address. The #32552 mapping census pin moves to its TO answer (`…a sealed type's census names neither holder's declared override (a mapping)`, empty census) — an intended move.
- `packages/objectql/src/protocol-custom-override-bare-slot-envelope.test.ts`: new describe `[#33131] two namespaces ship one name, one declares its override: each holder's address serves its own item` over nine types (page, app, dataset, doc, book, mapping, dashboard, report, email_template) — both orders × overridden holder, at once and after a restart, the env-wide list, an empty census; each holder disabled in turn; both overridden; the stranger CONTROL; the one-namespace CONTROL. Round 1 (N1): `… overridden: the read naming no package refuses 409 with both holders, and serves the enabled holder's own item with the other disabled`, both orders × {alpha, beta, both} overridden, eight types (`doc` left out: its bare read is not a package-scoped read and this change does not move it; measured identical on `main`).

Ablations (each with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` + `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs`, marker present in dist while mutated, absent after, `git status --porcelain` empty after):

| | mutation | red |
|:--|:--|:--|
| R1A3 | #33166's pair-row envelope rule off (`pairRowEnvelopeHolder` → `NOT_A_PAIR_ROW`), at head | 6 failed, 8 passed (the item-3 pins: one holder overridden and both overridden) |
| A2 | sealed branch of `declinesStoredRow` back to owner-only | 6 failed, 7 passed (the item-1 pins) |
| R1A2 | the same, against the round-1 N1 pins | 4 failed, 2 passed (the bare-read pins with a second-holder override) |
| A3 | census per-shipper set back to flow/action | 6 failed, 37 passed (the census pins, both files) |
| A4 | list filter type gate restored | 4 failed, 9 passed (the item-2 list pins) |

A1 (this PR's former hydrator helper) is retired with the helper; R1A3 replaces it against the rule the head serves by.

## Acceptance notes

- **S1 measured (round 1).** Both packages overridden: every read face (served list, execution view, by-name, layered) serves each package's own override in all four registration × save orders. The registry's `getPackageScopedItem('action', …)` keeps one bare slot per name: the override published last at its package, and the other package's own SHIPPED action at the other — never the other package's override (on `main` before #33166, alpha's registry item could read `OVR-B`). That is the registry's one-bare-slot model, not local to the hydrator, so it is pinned as it stands, the entry's `surface` and the changeset claim the registry face for one overridden package only, and the both-overridden registry face is carried on the card.
- **N3:** the entry's `acceptanceCriteria` names a pair's added member as a kept further list entry. **N2, N4:** accepted as they stand.
- **Items 4 and 5 are not in this PR.** Item 4 is measured as served by the #31593 moved-edit rule (`isMovedOverrideRowOf`); the maintainer ruled option A (6868829990): by design, pin only. Item 5 (a package holding a bundle name through its own stored row: its exact read served the pair's member, its lists left it out) is fixed on a local branch. Both follow on the card in their own PR after this one lands. #32606 is not folded here.
- **Item 2 deviation.** The order said fix item 2 only if the env-wide list drops the second holder's override. Measured: it does not drop it; it lists it twice, the extra entry stamped with the first-registered package (`Edited label beta` under `com.probe.alpha` beside `com.probe.beta`) — the same misattribution as item 3, so it is fixed here.
- **Census scope.** The census widening covers flow, action and the six sealed types only; every other type keeps the owner-only judgment it had.
- `origin/main` merged twice: once before opening, once in round 1 for the sibling #33166 landing on `protocol-registry-hydration.ts` (one conflict there, resolved to `main`'s side).
- Declared surface grep (`ruling|Ruling-ref|maintainer|⛔`) on `origin/main`: 58 hits in 4 of 9 files. Those beside an edited hunk, each kept: `protocol-diff-delete-load.ts` "⛔ The question is asked through the DOOR's own predicate" (the census widening mirrors the door's every-shipper judgment); `protocol-meta-list-reads.ts` [epic ruling 6761802819 on #31699] package-less withholding (untouched) and [#28390 ruling A] the bundle rule (kept via `baseServesBundleMember`). `protocol-registry-hydration.ts` carries no diff at this head, so its [#32568, epic ruling 6817768147] "⛔ Never a pick between two" sentence is untouched.

At round 1 every line answered 0 on its first run.

<details><summary>FROM readings (main before this PR and before #33166)</summary>

- Item 3: alpha first, only beta overridden — lists `alpha:OVR-B` + `beta:OVR-B`; beta first, only alpha overridden — `beta:OVR-A` + `alpha:OVR-A`; with the other holder disabled, `getPackageScopedItem` at the overridden holder answered SHIPPED. 4 failed, 6 passed.
- Item 1: the second holder's override of each sealed type declined at its address, plain and layered (shipped served), with the first holder disabled too; the census named it. The bare read with the first-registered holder disabled served the second holder's shipped item.
- Item 2: every one of the nine types listed the override twice, the extra entry under the first-registered package.
- S1, both overridden: the registry item at one holder could read the other holder's override.
